title: Urban Councils (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE URBAN COUNCILS ORDINANCE

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Urban Councils (Amendment) Act, No. 18 of 1987.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Urban Councils (Amendment) Act, No. 18 of 1987.

body.heading: Amendment of section 36 of Chapter 255.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 36 of the Urban Councils Ordinance (hereinafter referred to as the principal enactment") is hereby amended by the insertion, immediately after paragraph (h) of that section, of the following paragraphs: "(hh) to (i) prepare and submit to the appropriate authority, a programme for the provision of educational facilities such as buildings, furniture, playgrounds, hostels, teachers' quarters, sports materials and library facilities in the town;
